mapper.select: select mn.*, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Isbd_Fee_Type_Name ELSE iebd.Isbd_Fee_Type_Name END as Isbd_Fee_Type_Name, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Isbd_Type ELSE iebd.Isbd_Type END as Isbd_Type, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Isbd_Section_Type ELSE iebd.Isbd_Section_Type END as Isbd_Section_Type, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Isbd_Section_Name ELSE iebd.Isbd_Section_Name END as Isbd_Section_Name, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Isbd_Amount ELSE iebd.Isbd_Amount END as Isbd_Amount, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Isbd_Remark ELSE iebd.Isbd_Remark END as Isbd_Remark, ibbd.Isbd_Budget_Amount, ibbd.Isbd_Budget_Remark, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.Action_Display ELSE iebd.Action_Display END as Action_Display, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.sort ELSE iebd.sort END as sort, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.ie_detail_id ELSE iebd.ie_detail_id END as ie_detail_id, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.change_Type ELSE iebd.change_Type END as change_Type, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.work_measure ELSE iebd.work_measure END as work_measure, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.unit ELSE iebd.unit END as unit, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.unit_Price ELSE iebd.unit_Price END as unit_Price, CASE WHEN mn.Ibb_Id IS NOT NULL THEN ibbd.level_Code ELSE iebd.level_Code END as level_Code from Group_Fund_Plan_Detail_Subject mn left join Investment_Budget_Breakdown_Details ibbd on mn.Ibb_Id = ibbd.id left join Investment_Estimate_Breakdown_Details iebd on mn.ieb_Id = iebd.id where mn.gfp_Id = #{id}
